questions.question: Rohit is three times the age of his son Rishabh. Five years ago, he was four times older than Rishabh. What is Rohit’s age at present?
questions.solution:
Given: Rohit is three times the age of his son Rishabh. Five years ago, he was four times older than Rishabh.

Let the age of Rohit be 'A' and that of his son Rishabh's be 'B'.

Then, according to the question,

A = 3B, implies B = A/3

and,

A - 5 = 4 × (B - 5)

A - 5 = 4B - 20

4B = A - 5 + 20

4B = A + 15

By substituting above equation,

{4over3}A = A + 15 

{4over3}A - A = 15

{{4A -3 A}over3} = 15

A = 15 × 3

A = 45

Hence, Rohit's present age is **45 years.**

questions.question: From which of the following sources does the brain get energy?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Glucose.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Glucose:**__

 __
 
• Glucose is a** form of sugar.**
 
• It is the primary source of energy for every cell in the body.
 
• Because the brain is** so rich in nerve cells, or neurons it is the most energy-demanding organ, using one-half of all the sugar energy in the body.**
 
• Brain functions such as thinking, memory, and learning are closely linked to glucose levels and how efficiently the brain uses this fuel source.
 
• The effects of glucose and other forms of sugar on the brain may be the most profound in diabetes.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Fatty acids:**__

 __
 
• Fatty acids are the **building blocks of the fat in our bodies and in the food we eat.**
 
• During digestion, the body breaks down fats into fatty acids, which can then be absorbed into the blood.
 
• Fatty acid molecules are usually joined together in groups of three, forming a molecule called a triglyceride.
 
 
 
• **Amino acids:**__
 __
 
• Amino acids are **molecules that combine to form proteins.**
 
• It is the building block of life.
 
• The human body uses amino acids to make proteins to help the body break down food, grow, repair body tissue, perform many other body functions.
 
 
 
• **Nucleic acids:**__
 
 
• Nucleic acids are **naturally occurring chemical compounds that serve as the primary information-carrying molecules in cells.**
 
• **They play an important role in directing protein synthesis.**
 
• The two main classes of nucleic acids are deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) and ribonucleic acid (RNA).
